chunks: He has the keys of the heavens and the earth; and those who deny the revelations of God will be losers.

key_terms.مَقَالِيدُ: Keys (plural of miftah, indicating control or authority)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God holds the keys of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'keys' (Mafatih) symbolize God's exclusive control over all cosmic and terrestrial affairs, including revelation and sustenance, emphasizing His absolute authority. This verse, often cited in discussions of divine omnipotence, contrasts the believers' submission with the disbelievers' rejection of divine signs, marking them as the true losers in both worldly and eternal terms.
